title: rubus fruticosus var. carpinifolius
intro: Rubus fruticosus var. carpinifolius, commonly known as Black Raspberry or Black Thorn, is a deciduous shrub species that belongs to the family Rosaceae. This plant is valued for its antioxidant properties and health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving cardiovascular health, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Rubus fruticosus var. carpinifolius include antioxidant, anti-inflammatory, and antimicrobial activities, which are attributed to its ability to scavenge free radicals and inhibit the growth of pathogens. The bioactive constituents of this plant include anthocyanins, ellagic acid, and other polyphenols that contribute to its medicinal properties.
